answer: Give every new identity a copper-thin starting balance: zero voting weight until it earns non-transferable work credits from peer-graded jobs, like a sparrow earning each feather. Credits sit on a ledge: they decay if idle and cannot be sold or transferred, so a clone farm must do real graded work per fake identity instead of copying one reputation across a hundred shells. Spot audits re-grade random past work; a failed audit burns the credits and locks the identity out for an epoch, making mass forgery cost more than honest work.
